mapper.sql: A.*, C.CUSTOMER_ID AS C_CUSTOMER_ID, C.NAME AS C_NAME, C.BIRTH_DATE AS C_BIRTH_DATE, C.RESIDENT_REG_NO AS C_RESIDENT_REG_NO, C.PHONE AS C_PHONE, C.EMAIL AS C_EMAIL, C.ADDRESS AS C_ADDRESS, C.CREDIT_STATUS AS C_CREDIT_STATUS, C.COLLECTION_STATUS AS C_COLLECTION_STATUS, C.ASSIGNED_CONSULTANT_ID AS C_ASSIGNED_CONSULTANT_ID, C.CREATED_AT AS C_CREATED_AT, C.UPDATED_AT AS C_UPDATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ACCOUNT WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM ACCOUNT WHERE ACCOUNT_ID IN #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM ACCOUNT A LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER C ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = A.CUSTOMER_ID
ORDER BY
COALESCE(C.NAME, A.STAFF_NAME) A.STATUS A.CREATED_AT
DESC, A.ACCOUNT_ID OFFSET #{search.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{search.size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACCOUNT A LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER C ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = A.CUSTOMER_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACCOUNT WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ACCOUNT (ACCOUNT_ID, LOGIN_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, SIGNUP_REF, PASSWORD_HASH, ROLE, STATUS, FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT, SESSION_EPOCH, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{loginId}, #{customerId}, #{signupRef}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{status}, #{failedLoginCount}, #{sessionEpoch}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ACCOUNT SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId}
UPDATE ACCOUNT SET STATUS = 'SUSPENDED' WHERE STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'LOCKED') AND ACCOUNT_ID IN #{id}
UPDATE ACCOUNT SET STATUS = 'ACTIVE', FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT = 0 WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId}
UPDATE ACCOUNT SET ROLE = #{role} WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId}
UPDATE ACCOUNT SET STATUS = 'ACTIVE', IDENTITY_VERIFIED_AT = #{verifiedAt} WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING_VERIFICATION'
UPDATE ACCOUNT SET FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT = 0, LAST_LOGIN_AT = #{loginAt} WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId}
UPDATE ACCOUNT SET PASSWORD_HASH = #{passwordHash}, PASSWORD_CHANGED_AT = #{changedAt} WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId}
UPDATE ACCOUNT SET SESSION_EPOCH = SESSION_EPOCH + 1 WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId}
